title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1966-09-16

ai_review.summary: A tight 1966 set with standout Pigpen‑driven Midnight Hour and a fiery Dancing in the Streets jam, captured on a mostly clear soundboard recording that has only slight buzz/clipping.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as one of the best from ’66 – vocals are strong, the band plays tight and Jerry’s soloing shines, especially during the Dancing in the Streets jam. Pigpen dominates with an epic Midnight Hour that reviewers call a must‑hear, and early Rider’s add extra sparkle. The soundboard source provides good overall clarity; a few listeners note minor buzz or clipping on certain tracks but the audio is generally excellent for its era.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers gave 5‑star ratings, highlighting a high‑energy performance and solid recording quality with only minor technical quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and listenable; some reviewers mention slight buzz/clip on a few songs and a faint white‑noise hiss, but overall the audio is strong for a 1966 capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, well‑structured set with strong vocal work and seamless transitions; early material feels cohesive and energetic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Great soloing noted especially on the Dancing in the Streets jam; described as tearing it up.
band_member_comments.Phil: Positive nod to Lesh’s continuing ‘torch’; no specific bass comments.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals and guitar work praised as better than many ’66 shows, with Bob sounding good throughout.
